title: Slice of Paradise | KEY.co
description_expanded: The crown jewel of this magnificent home is the fourth-floor chef’s kitchen and the breathtaking rooftop balcony, complete with a private pool that can be heated upon request. The kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and an oversized marble island that invites social cooking and dining experiences. The rooftop balcony, however, offers an unparalleled opportunity to bask in the beauty of the beach and the Gulf, providing a serene backdrop for unforgettable moments. Whether one desires to enjoy a morning swim with a view, host a sunset dinner, or simply relax under the stars, this private oasis in the sky makes every moment extraordinary. This luxurious retreat is not just a place to stay; it's a destination that offers everything one needs for a dream vacation, promising memories that will last a lifetime. Immerse yourself in luxury and serenity at this opulent vacation home, designed to accommodate up to 18 guests with unparalleled comfort and elegance. This splendid retreat features eight well-appointed bedrooms and seven full bathrooms, alongside an additional half bath, ensuring that every guest experiences utmost convenience and privacy. From the moment one steps inside, the grandeur of the living spaces unfolds, offering a tranquil sanctuary with breathtaking views that invite relaxation and rejuvenation. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a first-floor living area that exudes comfort and a serene ambiance, complemented by a convenient kitchenette and two cozy guest bedrooms, each designed to provide a restful night's sleep after a day of exploration and fun.
